description: Recorded search results, newest first. Filter by keyword, by source, and by free text scoped to result titles, to the transcripts of imported Twitter Spaces, or to both. Each entry reports its source, url, title, author, state and datetime, plus whether a transcript is available and the broadcast_id to pass to get_transcript.

keyword_id.description: Restrict to one keyword, by id from list_keywords.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging through `total`.

query.description: Free text to match. Omit to list everything.

search_in.description: Where to match `query`: result titles, Twitter Space transcripts, or both. Defaults to both. Ignored without `query`.

source.description: Restrict to one source, from list_sources.

name: search_results
title: Search the result history
